review.notes: Sole-maintainer approval after replacing the expected-only UploadInput import with a candidate-independent browser harness that mounts the real FormBook path present at both frozen revisions. Two clean Chromium 1228 executions at expected commit bb32b7a5c94a5b4de37fda0a8669f3d26e0b9c27 passed all 12 integrated checks; two clean executions at base commit 795d311d1d8b8e502eb7f33b9b6d4475691d3101 failed the 10 absent upload behaviors while still mounting the book form and retaining a clean console. The oracle observes four-locale label/helper rendering, RTL direction, click and keyboard selection, pending/success/error, live-region feedback, preview, same-file replacement, drag/drop, form serialization, clear, disabled behavior, scoped Axe results, and console errors without naming any allowed implementation module. This approval is maintainer qualification, not independent model-output review.
